items.html: And the matter is that the Name Sag is the sum total of Taamim, Nekudot, Tagin, and Otiot [cantillation marks, dots, crowns, and letters]; however, those that are only the Nekudot of Sag are not called Sag like the whole, for they are but a single detail within the Name Sag. Therefore, when this detail, which is the Nekudot, joins with the Name Mah, and becomes to it the aspect of a Nukva, it is now called by the Name Ban.
